description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three text annotation tools—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two categories of Twitter data: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” with the latter encompassing all tweets including those with emojis. The vertical y-axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2, while the horizontal x-axis displays the two tweet categories. For “Emoji Tweets,” TEXTBLOB (hatched bar) achieves approximately 0.35 accuracy, VADER (solid gray bar) reaches around 0.5, and ChatGPT (solid green bar) attains the highest accuracy at approximately 0.65. In the “Overall Tweet” category, TEXTBLOB’s accuracy drops slightly to about 0.3, VADER remains near 0.5, and ChatGPT again leads with approximately 0.65 accuracy. The chart visually emphasizes ChatGPT’s consistent superior performance across both tweet types, with its green bars significantly taller than the others, while VADER shows moderate and stable performance, and TEXTBLOB underperforms in both conditions. The legend on the right clarifies the color and pattern coding for each tool, and the chart title “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis” indicates the comparative scope of the evaluation.
